name: Ritmo de Escritura
description: Analiza writing cadence and rhythm patrones.
useCase: Detección de texto IA mediante regularidad metronómica
mechanism: Calcula autocorrelación of row energy para detectar periodic patrones. AI text shows metronomic regularity, while escritura humana has natural cadence variations.
source: Tay et al. (2020) - Comparative Study of Human vs. Machine Generated Text
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: adaptativo, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropía, CV, correlación
strengths:
- Effective for detecting generado por IA text
- Language-agnostic estadístico approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger falsos positivos
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies a través de estilo de escrituras

references.title: Tay et al. (2020) - Comparative Study of Human vs. Machine Generated Text
Neal, T. et al. (2018). Surveying Stylometry Techniques and Applications. ACM Computing Surveys.
Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
